title: Spend the Night at the Aquarium
seo_title: Spend the Night at the Aquarium in Springfield, MO
description: Spend the Night at the Aquarium is a WildNIGHT overnight at Wonders of Wildlife where you decorate glowing deep-sea desserts, search exhibits for interactive light stations, and watch a movie with popcorn before falling asleep near an aquarium exhibit. It is designed for families with children ages 5 and up and ties in with the Sea of Lights Enchanted Christmas event. It takes place December 12, 2026 (Time TBD) at 550 W Sunshine St in Springfield, MO.
address: 550 W Sunshine St, Springfield, MO 65807-2436, United States, Springfield, MO
